judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and handles missing per-round usage without producing `NaN` or erasing prior counts. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the public hook signature/type to make aggregation unambiguous (`OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` still names the parameter `usage` instead of `totalUsage`, which the candidate's own unchecked `.lore/dod.md` facet notes). In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, it leaves the updated `afterModelResponse` behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading rather than promoting it to the main specification and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. Finally, it scatters the helper and tests across four new files (`turnUsage.ts` and three separate test files) and leaves `.lore/dod.md` and tooling script edits in the diff, whereas the reference keeps `accumulateUsage` local to `chatOrchestrator.ts` and extends `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
